name: zkpcare-visualizer
description: Interactive step-by-step scenario for zkpCare — real ZK proof generation

scripts.start: concurrently -n SEQ,UI -c blue,green "npm run sequencer" "npm run dev"
scripts.clean: powershell -Command "& ./kill-ports.ps1; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .parcel-cache -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Get-ChildItem dist -Exclude flowchart -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output 'Cache cleared (dist/flowchart preserved)'"
scripts.dev: parcel src/index.html src/interactive.html src/member.html src/prescriber.html src/pharmacy.html src/insurer.html src/sequencer.html --port 1234
scripts.start:scenarios: concurrently -n SEQ,UI,RUN -c blue,green,yellow "npm run sequencer" "npm run dev" "node engine/scenario-runner.mjs"
scripts.start:scenarios:clean: npm run clean && npm run start:scenarios
scripts.start:flowchart:clean: npm run clean && npm run start:flowchart
scripts.start:old: concurrently -n SEQ,VIZ,RUN -c blue,green,yellow "npx tsx engine/start-sequencer.ts" "parcel src/index.html --port 1234" "npx tsx engine/scenario-runner.ts"
